description: The deemed-accept boundary for the January-2026 tax period, asserted at the instant BEFORE and the instant AFTER, and then asserted again with the SAME two instants written in UTC. Without the UTC pair, an engine that evaluates the boundary in the server's local zone passes every IST-written test and then deem-accepts records 5h30m late on a UTC host — into the wrong GSTR-2B.
